title: Comparing structure sheaves for nested full subcategories of the big site
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma compares structure sheaves for two nested full subcategories C_1 subset C_2 of a big site: the inclusion is fully faithful, continuous and cocontinuous, and the canonical map g_!O_1 -> O_2 is an isomorphism (statement lines 7069-7099). Part (a) is immediate, but part (b) is a real computation of a colimit presheaf: surjectivity uses the affine line, which the hypotheses force to lie in C_1, to exhibit any section as a pullback (proof lines 7125-7131), while injectivity requires rewriting a finite sum of colimit generators as a single generator over a product of affine lines and then observing that a vanishing sum factors through a hyperplane, again an object of C_1 by the closure hypotheses (proof lines 7134-7153). The non-formal content is this use of the closure hypotheses, in particular products with affine space. The claim is H2: one serious colimit computation with both inclusions verified.
